scripts.start: npm run build:web && npm run start -w server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.desktop: npm run build:web && npm run build -w server && npm run dev -w desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w domain && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w domain && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:web
